question: What designation is given to the independent family-impellers in relation to the four ages, as addressed to the lord of gods?
premises: They are designated as caturyuga thus.
They are addressed in relation to the lord of gods.
They are described as independent family-impellers.
inference: The independent family-impellers are designated by the term caturyuga in this address.
plain_english: Thus, O lord of gods, the independent family-impellers are called the four ages.
